name: Prefect MCP Server
summary: Official read-only MCP server for inspecting Prefect Cloud and self-hosted runs, logs and docs; hosted OAuth endpoint at prefect.fastmcp.app/mcp or local uvx. MIT; README warns it is experimental.
description: Official PrefectHQ repository (MIT, not archived). The README opens with a warning: 'under active development and may change drastically at any time', an experimental MCP server. It gives MCP clients read-only tools to inspect Prefect Cloud and self-hosted Prefect (workspaces, flow runs, logs, workspace health) plus a docs proxy; the hosted tools 'do not change Prefect state'. Hosted: Prefect operates https://prefect.fastmcp.app/mcp using HTTP MCP OAuth (Prefect Cloud sign-in, then you choose which workspaces the client may read); no API key is needed. Probe 2026-11-28 (unauthenticated, no tool calls): GET returned HTTP 405; POST initialize returned HTTP 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://prefect.fastmcp.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"`. The README also documents Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add prefecthq/prefect-mcp-server`, `/plugin install prefect`), Codex, ChatGPT plugin and Claude connector setups that use the same OAuth endpoint. Local: `uvx --from prefect-mcp prefect-mcp-server` with PREFECT_API_URL and PREFECT_API_KEY (or PREFECT_API_AUTH_STRING for basic-auth self-hosted servers); a team HTTP deployment can take per-request headers. README suggests read-only service accounts (Pro and Enterprise) for extra safety. Free to use the server; Prefect Cloud plans are separate. No telemetry statement was found in the README. Documented installs were not executed and no Prefect account was created.

agent_access.notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP with Prefect Cloud OAuth (no API key). Probe 2026-11-28: bare GET 405; unauthenticated initialize 401 with OAuth resource_metadata. Local uvx stdio uses PREFECT_API_URL/PREFECT_API_KEY. README: experimental; read-only tools. No tools were called and no account was created.
